title: Parcel setbacks and access
goal: A reader must be able to identify the parcel dimensions, distinguish all four setback lines from the property boundaries, and trace vehicle and pedestrian access from the street to the building.

rubric.must: The parcel is a closed rectangle with a heavier continuous boundary visibly distinct from the four dashed setback lines inside it.
Four visible setback lines are individually labelled Rear setback 6 m, Front setback 8 m, West setback 5 m, and East setback 5 m beside the corresponding sides.
The closed building footprint lies entirely inside all four setback lines, with visible clearance from each line and each property boundary.

The 30 m parcel-width dimension spans the two ends of the horizontal property boundary, and the 40 m parcel-depth dimension spans the two ends of the vertical property boundary, without terminating on a setback or building edge.
A continuous wide driveway connects the street to the building, with its route visible through the frontage and setback crossing and unobscured by annotations.
A narrower pedestrian path visibly connects the street to the marked building entrance, remains distinct from the driveway, and is not hidden by labels or callouts.
A legible north arrow points toward the rear of the parcel, a scale bar is visible, and the street, building, setback, and dimension labels can all be read without overlapping one another.

ideal.notes: Drafted by Codex from the source, the rubric and the siteplan exemplar, without seeing the engine's own output.

review.evidence: The drawing visibly satisfies the complete site-plan intent: parcel boundaries and dimensions are clear, all four setbacks are dashed and labelled, the building is inside them, and separate vehicle and pedestrian routes connect the street to the building.

items.evidence: The parcel is a closed rectangle drawn with a heavy continuous black line, clearly distinct from the lighter dashed setback rectangle inside.
All four dashed sides are visible and individually labelled: Rear setback 6 m, Front setback 8 m, West setback 5 m, and East setback 5 m.
The closed grey building footprint lies entirely within the dashed setback rectangle, with visible clearance on every side.
The 30 m parcel width dimension spans the left and right ends of the top property boundary, while the 40 m parcel depth dimension spans the top and bottom ends of the left property boundary.
A wide, clearly outlined driveway runs continuously from the street across the front property boundary and setback to the building's front edge; its route is unobscured.
A narrower 1.2 m pedestrian path runs separately from the street to the visibly marked entrance on the building, remaining distinguishable from the driveway.
A legible north arrow points upward toward the parcel rear, a 0–20 m graphic scale is visible, and the street, building, setback, and dimension labels are readable without material overlap.
